d: Short, honey-blonde hair with straight bangs and a long, braided ponytail tied with a red bead. Large, gentle amber eyes with a youthful, cheerful expression on a face with the apparent maturity of a child. A slender build, wearing a red short-sleeved shirt under a brown animal-eared hood, a tan fur scarf, and a red-lined patched cloak. The outfit includes black shorts with a green zig-zag hem, a brown belt with a small knife and colorful beads, a green wristwatch, red socks, and chunky black platform shoes. A large grey axe is carried across the shoulders.
